name: Reprompt
long_description:
Reprompt builds AI Agents for Location-- Mapping companies like Radar and TomTom use our agents to get live information about a point of interest or business that keeps their maps up to date. 

To do this we have an internal agents platform that supports Web, Vision, Doc Reading, and soon self-driving browser agents.

launches.title: Reprompt AI: Helping AI apps get to production quality 10x faster
launches.tagline: AI teams use Reprompt to evaluate and improve their apps without code
launches.body:
**tldr:** Productionizing AI apps is hard. [**Reprompt**](https://repromptai.com/) lets teams evaluate and improve their apps without code and get to production quality 10x faster.

### **90% of Generative AI pilots never make it to production**

Generative AI applications are notoriously hard to scale to production quality:

* Hallucinations are hard to detect and fix
* Function calling is a huge opportunity but still hit-or-miss
* RAGs aren’t as scalable as we hoped, and often they find the wrong documents
* AI responses can become a legal and compliance liability

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79428&key=user_uploads/89898/2b3dd321-4e55-48ad-8771-3f2c0526107c)

### **Getting to production takes more than great prompt engineering**

Behind the scenes of every great product (Uber, Doordash, Waymo, Robinhood) there's an ops team with a dashboard full of if statements and data overrides that keeps the whole company from collapsing.

From what we’re seeing, AI apps will require similar tuning, using strategies like Human-In-The-Loop, custom overrides, multi-queries, and prompt splitting/routing.

### **Reprompt helps AI teams fix “last mile” AI issues so they can ship faster**

Here’s what you can do with Reprompt:

1. Trace your AI calls across chat, RAG, and function calls to make debugging easy
2. Automatically track and highlight hallucinations and file them as bugs
3. Write custom prompt overrides to handle the edge cases **without changing your main prompt or pushing code**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79428&key=user_uploads/64967/5434ca4f-a3ef-4085-966d-b7a4fbf43f87)

### **About the team**

[Lukas Martinelli](https://linkedin.com/in/lukas-martinelli) was an Engineering Director and GM of Search at Mapbox. He also led Mapbox's 120-person labeling and evaluation team.

[Rob Balian](https://linkedin.com/in/robbalian) led Robinhood's Growth team through Covid, Gamestop, and IPO. He was an early PM at Facebook.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79428&key=user_uploads/64967/808fb8ba-68a8-476e-ab28-c744d4acf70d)

_Rob Balian and Lukas Martinelli_

If your team has challenges getting to production-level quality, we’d love to [show you a demo](https://cal.com/robbalian/reprompt-demo-with-rob). See you all in production!

\-Rob and Lukas
